provenance.fixture_recipe: Deterministic synthetic wide universe (P25 recipe). BTC prices from tests/fixtures/real_market_prices.csv. Asset returns = beta * BTC_return + idio, idio ~ N(0, 0.003), betas linspace(0.35, 1.9, 40). One all-NaN DEL column for loader robustness. Not real market data; not market profitability evidence.
